t: 托马斯·杰斐逊和五人委员会向第二届大陆大会提交"美国独立宣言"草案,宣言命令其"躺在桌上"供大…
te: Thomas Jefferson and the Committee of Five present the draft of the United States Declaration of Independence to the Se…
dz: 美国革命:托马斯·杰斐逊和五人委员会向第二届大陆大会提交"美国独立宣言"草案,宣言命令其"躺在桌上"供大会进一步编辑.
de: American Revolution: Thomas Jefferson and the Committee of Five present the draft of the United States Declaration of Independence to the Second Continental Congress, which orders it to "lie on the table" for further edits by the assembly.

t: 一支新英格兰殖民军队在路易斯堡(英语:Louisbourg (New Style))夺取了法国…
te: A New England colonial army captures the French fortifications at Louisbourg (New Style).
dz: 一支新英格兰殖民军队在路易斯堡(英语:Louisbourg (New Style))夺取了法国的防御工事.
de: A New England colonial army captures the French fortifications at Louisbourg (New Style).

t: 波兰与乌克兰的贝雷斯特克战役开始.
te: The Battle of Berestechko between Poland and Ukraine starts.
dz: 波兰与乌克兰的贝雷斯特克战役开始.
de: The Battle of Berestechko between Poland and Ukraine starts.

t: 瓜德罗普成为了法国的殖民地.
te: Guadeloupe becomes a French colony.
dz: 瓜德罗普成为了法国的殖民地.
de: Guadeloupe becomes a French colony.

t: 织田信长与德川家康联军长筱之战取得胜利。
te: The combined forces of Oda Nobunaga and Tokugawa Ieyasu are victorious in the Battle of Nagashino.
dz: 日本战国时代：织田信长与德川家康联军长筱之战取得胜利。
de: Sengoku period of Japan: The combined forces of Oda Nobunaga and Tokugawa Ieyasu are victorious in the Battle of Nagashino.

t: 查理五世被选为神圣罗马帝国皇帝.
te: Charles V is elected Emperor of the Holy Roman Empire.
dz: 查理五世被选为神圣罗马帝国皇帝.
de: Charles V is elected Emperor of the Holy Roman Empire.

t: 一支法国部队在塞纳拉战役中大量击败了更大的尼阿波利坦和西班牙军队,导致贡萨洛·德·科尔多瓦创建…
te: A French force heavily defeats a much larger Neapolitan and Spanish army at the battle of Seminara, leading to the crea…
dz: 一支法国部队在塞纳拉战役中大量击败了更大的尼阿波利坦和西班牙军队,导致贡萨洛·德·科尔多瓦创建了特尔西奥斯人.
de: A French force heavily defeats a much larger Neapolitan and Spanish army at the battle of Seminara, leading to the creation of the Tercios by Gonzalo de Córdoba.

t: 三月的爱德华被加冕为英格兰国王爱德华四世.
te: Edward, Earl of March, is crowned King Edward IV of England.
dz: 三月的爱德华被加冕为英格兰国王爱德华四世.
de: Edward, Earl of March, is crowned King Edward IV of England.

t: 穆哈迈德六世在杀死了同父异母的弟弟伊斯梅尔二世后,成为格拉纳达的第十任纳斯里德国王.
te: Muhammed VI becomes the tenth Nasrid king of Granada after killing his brother-in-law Ismail II.
dz: 穆哈迈德六世在杀死了同父异母的弟弟伊斯梅尔二世后,成为格拉纳达的第十任纳斯里德国王.
de: Muhammed VI becomes the tenth Nasrid king of Granada after killing his brother-in-law Ismail II.

t: 第一次十字军东征的战士在安条克战役中击败了摩苏尔的克博加。
te: Fighters of the First Crusade defeat Kerbogha of Mosul at the battle of Antioch.
dz: 第一次十字军东征的战士在安条克战役中击败了摩苏尔的克博加。
de: Fighters of the First Crusade defeat Kerbogha of Mosul at the battle of Antioch.
